## Description

Proposed hierarchical approach to factor risk-parity allocation: Estimate factor volatility and dependence, then choose portfolio weights so risk contributions align with a target risk budget. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
